text: The ΜΕΓΑΛΟΣ ΔΙΑΓΩΝΙΣΜΟΣ overlay (templates/contest.html + functions/api/contest.js) is a REAL contest, not just a site gag: the prize is two PyCon 2026 tickets, and the owner announces the winner on Discord. Entries only exist as Discord messages — there is no database record. The owner initially reused the existing DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL, then reversed that on 2026-09-05: contest entries now post to their own webhook, read from DISCORD_CONTEST_WEBHOOK_URL, so they land in a channel separate from presentation proposals. All Greek copy in the overlay was approved verbatim by the owner (including the 'Μαλακία' clear button); do not reword it without asking.

Staff session keys from the old database-backed sessions remain in the git history of db.sqlite3, across roughly 35 commits of that file, in the public repo. On 2026-09-15 the owner decided this is acceptable and explicitly declined a history rewrite: sessions were moved to the local-memory cache and the django_session table was dropped, so nothing new leaks, but the historical rows were left in place. Do not propose rewriting history over this again without asking. The practical risk is near zero because the public site is static HTML and no Django server is ever reachable where an old session key could be replayed. Related and still open, though never raised as a task: SECRET_KEY is committed in the clear in pythess/settings.py and DEBUG is True. The public SECRET_KEY is the reason signed-cookie sessions were rejected in favour of memory.
